hook_line: MAMDANI DANCES GARBA AFTER TEMPLE PLOT

hook_stat.sub: Members of Congress urging an FBI hate-crime investigation into the Aurora temple attempt

stats.label: Attempted shooting outside the Aurora Balaji temple on the first day of Navratri
Age of the suspect whose rifle jammed outside the temple

diaspora_bullets: Raja Krishnamoorthi led the 105 lawmakers — he was worshipping at the temple with his family
Queens is home to one of the largest Hindu communities in the United States
news_summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani joined Hindu New Yorkers in Queens to celebrate Navratri, Durga Puja, Dashain and Vijayadashami, calling for unity after the attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois.
payoff: The Aurora case now moves through the courts while the FBI decides on the hate-crime investigation lawmakers requested.
